correctness.rationale: The three-state Markov ODE and Ito equation Mprime=2D p_A-rM give the verified rational Laplace resolvent 2D(s+q)^2/[s(s+r)((s+q)^2+r(s+2q))], and M∞=2Dq/[r(q+2r)]. The nonstationary pair discriminant is r(r-4q), the residue of -r is -2D(q-r)^2/(rq^2), cancelling only r=q. For r/q in (0,4), the two real/oscillatory envelopes imply infinite strict crossings if r=q or 2<=r/q<4, including x=2 where the cosine amplitude 2/sqrt5 exceeds offset 1/2. At x=4 and x>4 the solution is a real exponential polynomial, with finitely many zeros. Near x=1, e^{delta u} barrier against positive cosine lobes gives two simple roots per full lobe until U_x=(1/delta)log(A/eta); omega->sqrt3/2, delta->1/2, eta=(x-1)^2/x, so N=(2sqrt3/pi)log(1/|x-1|)+O(1). This counts mean-square displacement sign reversals, not sample-path crossings or tangent zero contacts.
